codeSystems.name: HemOnc
codeSystems.title: HemOnc Ontology (fragment, Phase 0 spike)
codeSystems.description: Fragment of the HemOnc ontology, sufficient to support the Carboplatin + Paclitaxel Variant #83 example used in the Phase 0 spike. The full CodeSystem will be emitted as content=complete from the OMOP concept_stage table in a later phase.

codeSystems.name: HemOncSigTargetType
codeSystems.title: HemOnc Sig Dose Target Type
codeSystems.description: Small code system distinguishing the *target* expressed by a Sig's doseQuantity from the *computed* mg dose. Used as ActivityDefinition.dosage.doseAndRate.type. A target requires a CQL helper to convert into an administered mg quantity at $apply time.
